title: A single-source halt (Nordkamp, PCM-7)
question: Which products, orders and cash does the Nordkamp halt touch, and what do we do before cover runs out?

record_case.finding: The qualified PO to Tornelis was the right bridge; the exposure was real.

steps.note: One sound case. Four more, clean, and the Head of Supply Chain is offered a step up.
